Hi Alex —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our call:
- Your primary goal: lower per-call latency for your chat assistant and reduce inference cost at peak.
- Current constraints: multi-regional traffic, strict PII retention policies, and an internal SLA of <150ms p95 for short queries.
- Success criteria: 20-30% cost reduction while meeting latency targets and retaining current quality.

Next step: schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive + live demo where Rafael (solutions engineer) can run through integration details, model variants, and a short perf demo. Below are a few times that work on our side next week (all PT):
- Tue 2027-04-06: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2027-04-07: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your team will attend? If none of these fit, share a couple of alternatives and we’ll adapt.

I attached a one-page recap and proposed agenda. I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
